summary: Iter 45 — Smart Combobox auto-fill + branded PDFs. Backend pytest 6/6 PASS (carriers/directory rich shape, includes XPO Logistics + Schneider National curated names, ?q=Sch filter works, customers/directory rich shape, legacy /carriers simple endpoint still works, quote PDF 427KB > 50KB threshold). Frontend E2E confirmed: (a) /brokerage Load Boards → Book dialog → CarrierCombobox (data-testid='book-carrier-name') renders → typing 'Sch' filters dropdown to 3 items (Schneider booking · Hirschbach · Schneider National curated) with metadata badges → clicking 'Schneider' sets carrier input. (b) /brokerage Accounting → + Invoice → CustomerCombobox (data-testid='invoice-customer') renders → typing 'a' shows 4 customers with payment terms + AP email. (c) /orisei-operations Rate Confirmations → rc-name combobox shows XPO. (d) /book-load page has carrier-select combobox (3 items for 'XP') + commodity-input with datalist. (e) Quotes form has 3 inputs with HTML datalist attached (origin/destination cities, equipment, commodities). PDFs are 427KB branded reportlab output.

integration_issues.flow: Book Load → CarrierCombobox auto-fill of MC#
integration_issues.issue: MC# field stays empty when picking 'Schneider' because the backend directory currently has no MC stored for ANY carrier (all returned items have mc=null — both booking-derived rows and curated big-board names). Auto-fill code path is correct; this is purely a seed-data limitation. Once any booking carries carrier_mc, future picks of that carrier will populate the MC field.

action_items: Optional seed enhancement: pre-populate carrier_mc on at least one curated/sample carrier (e.g., Schneider National → MC-378401) so the MC auto-fill flow is demoable out-of-the-box. Code is correct, only data is missing.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/autocomplete.py L177-187: booking carrier aggregation reads `row.get('contact_email')` / `row.get('contact_phone')` from the $group result, but the pipeline aliases those keys via $last as 'contact_email'/'contact_phone' — so this works, however the source field names in the underlying brokerage_bookings doc are `carrier_contact_email` / `carrier_contact_phone`. The {$last: '$carrier_contact_email'} aliasing to 'contact_email' is fine; just verify all writers (Book Load route, rate-con issuance) actually persist `carrier_contact_email` consistently or the contact will always be null.

backend/routes/autocomplete.py: `/carriers/directory` and `/customers/directory` routes are declared AFTER `/{kind}` in `build_autocomplete_router`. FastAPI route registration order matters when paths overlap; ‘/carriers/directory’ has two segments so `/{kind}` doesn’t collide today, but if someone adds `/{kind}/{sub}` later this will silently swallow the rich endpoint. Consider explicitly registering specific routes BEFORE the generic `/{kind}` for safety.

backend/routes/orisei_docs.py L831 TOTAL_PATTERN: only matches markdown lines starting with literal '## ' that contain the word 'Total'. Rate confirmations / invoices that use '### Grand Total' or '**Total Due: $...**' won't render as the gold callout. Consider relaxing the pattern (e.g., any heading line containing 'Total|Amount Due|Grand Total').

rca of the issue: MC auto-fill no-op observed in CarrierCombobox: NOT a bug. Backend /api/autocomplete/carriers/directory currently returns mc=null for every carrier (both booking aggregation — because no prior booking stored carrier_mc — and curated entries which intentionally have mc=null). The CarrierCombobox onSelect handler in Brokerage.jsx correctly reads the picked record's mc and writes it into book-carrier-mc, but with mc=null nothing is filled. To validate the auto-fill code path, manually POST a brokerage_bookings doc with carrier_mc='MC-378401' and pick that carrier in the dialog → MC will populate. Recommend the main agent seed at least one carrier_mc value.
